claims: Punch (or Punch-kun) is a viral baby Japanese macaque at Ichikawa City Zoo in Japan, according to Wikipedia and Instagram posts.
Punch gained international attention in early 2026 after being abandoned by his mother, according to Wikipedia and Instagram posts.
Zoo staff gave Punch a stuffed orangutan for comfort.
Punch was frequently seen clutching the stuffed orangutan, according to Instagram users.
Images and videos of Punch carrying his stuffed orangutan around went viral, according to USA Today and TODAY.com.
Images and videos of Punch carrying his stuffed orangutan around led to an increase in visitors at Ichikawa City Zoo, according to USA Today and TODAY.com.
As of late March 2026, Punch is slowly socializing with other macaques, according to USA Today and Facebook reports.
As of late March 2026, Punch is reducing his reliance on the plush toy, according to USA Today and Facebook reports.
Punch was born July 26, 2025, according to Wikipedia.
Punch is a macaque, according to Wikipedia.
Punch is sometimes referred to as a "snow monkey," according to Wikipedia.
The "Punch Monkey" from "The Croods" movie franchise is a different, fictional character, mentioned in The Croods Wiki.
